lines.say: Hey, students with A D H D. Does this sound like you?
Called lazy at every parents' evening. Capable, but lazy. Detentions. Isolation rooms.
That was my brother. He knew hundreds of car models before most kids could read.
Effort was never the problem. Starting was. Tracking was. Time was.
He was diagnosed at eighteen. After his A-levels.
So we built the plan he never had.
Offload holds the plan, and moves it when your day falls apart.
Comment plan if this was you too.
